title: Clear a stale native delegation parent from a mirrored session retained across a browser reconnect
outcome: An open browser holds a remote proxy with remoteId set and a stale native parentDelegationId. A subsequent backend restart provides a summary and detail for the same proxy without the parent. preserveExistingParentDelegationId restores the stale parent from browser state, hiding the still-unclassified proxy while its owner is offline and risking saved-tab pruning. This is the client-side counterpart to the owner-only offline classification rule called out in w-314a5d481df3. Existing local child ownership must still survive omitted markers where appropriate.
acceptance: An already-open browser adopts cleared native-parent metadata from a restarted backend for an unclassified proxy, keeps the proxy visible until verified owner classification, and retains its saved tab. Cover matching-stamp summary and targeted detail adoption without changing local-child ownership behaviour.
